Gold, Silver, and Fuel Prices Unchanged on September 7

On September 7, the prices of petrol and diesel remained unchanged across major Indian cities including Delhi, Mumbai, Chennai, and Kolkata. Similarly, the rates for gold and silver also saw no fluctuation on this date in Delhi, Mumbai, and Kolkata. The coverage provided the latest retail rates for 24K and 22K gold, as well as 999 silver, alongside MCX market updates.
